name: Trooper
description: A battle-hardened space marine in her thirties who sings soaring power metal and treats every chorus as a rally cry.
build: Strong and athletic under armour, made massive by it: huge rounded shoulder plates, a thick chest plate and heavy greaves give a blocky, top-heavy, wide silhouette with a small head. Never slim-waisted, pin-up or exposed.
face: A square-jawed determined face with warm brown skin, a small white scar through the character-left eyebrow, strong dark brows, steady hazel eyes and a wide confident mouth.
hair: A short dark-brown undercut, shaved at the sides, with the top swept back and slightly flattened as if just out of a helmet.
outfit: Chunky rounded plated armour in bright orange with off-white panels: oversized dome shoulder pauldrons, a thick segmented chest plate, a wide armoured belt, heavy thigh plates, big boxy knee guards, armoured forearm gauntlets and large chunky boots. A dark grey padded bodysuit shows at the neck, elbows and joints. A few scuffs and chipped paint on the plates. No helmet anywhere.
personality: Loud, loyal and fearless; a big-hearted squad leader.
performance_style: Wide heroic power stance with the feet planted apart, chest out, the free character-left gauntleted fist raised to shoulder height, chin up with a fierce grin.
location: A starship hangar bay: a floor of yellow-and-grey hazard-striped steel deck plating running to the bottom of the frame, a clean back wall of tall grey blast doors with orange warning lights along the top, and cold white overhead floodlight.
recognition_cues: a bare head with a short dark undercut
avoid: a helmet worn, carried, held or at her feet
a rifle, blaster, knife, sword or any weapon
exposed midriff, cleavage or skin-tight armour
insignia, rank badges, skulls, eagles or unit markings

animations.dance: Power-metal headbang loop: from the planted opening stance, pump the free fist up and down in time, headbang with the undercut flopping, step the character-left foot forward into a lunging rock stance, windmill the free arm once, then step back and return to the exact opening stance with the fist at shoulder height. Low stomps only, no kicks.

sing.intent: Power-metal anthem loop: lean back, throw the chin up on a soaring high note and punch the free gauntlet skyward, then pull it back to shoulder height. The mouth must visibly open wide and change shape across the loop, from a shout to a held open vowel, so she unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief room-sound startle: the big pauldrons hitch up, the eyes snap sideways alert, then she rolls her neck and resettles into her power stance. No opponent or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: turn one shoulder forward so the dome pauldron leads and raise the free forearm gauntlet in front of the face, then hold a braced planted stance. Not a combat attack.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: march in with heavy clanking strides, stop with a stomp, roll the armoured shoulders, and plant into her wide power stance.
animations.victory: One-shot finish: raise the free fist high overhead with a triumphant roar, then bring it down to thump the chest plate and hold a proud chest-out stance.
animations.ko: Non-contact performance defeat: she stays on her feet while the fight drains out — the heavy pauldrons sag, the arms hang loose, and her head drops forward with the eyes shut. She holds a standing, visibly spent finish, braced upright by the heavy armour. She remains standing on both feet in every frame — no kneeling, crouching, sitting, sinking, or going to the ground. Do not imply a hit or opponent.
